reviewed_by: Claude Code after independent subagent root-cause validation and scratch-Core reproduction
reason: Automatic recovery replaces a prepared target that ended before it took the project with a fresh preparation under its own operation identity, and settles a preparation left uncertain by a dead host from its spawn checkpoint and process row (recording the exact unconfirmed worker's readiness first). A failed execution process now exits unless it is quiescing, relinquishing or closing, so a never-served first start, a restoration that ran a control, or one that failed after verification no longer keeps renewing a failed grant. Selected: the auto-recovery suite (dead, retired and live prepared targets; verified, unanswering and retired uncertain preparations), restoration and worker exit regressions, the held-control failure, and the recovery reconciliation cases around held, mismatched and waiting restorations, on SQLite and PostgreSQL.
exclusions: test_retained_prepared_worker_survives_host_detach_and_new_host_activates_saved_recovery needs a pidfd-capable process host (fails locally on main too). No UI, native or Playwright layer: no operator-visible surface changed beyond existing diagnostics. All four workflows were reproduced on a fault-injected scratch Core on main (STUCK) and on this branch (PASS). No settings or settings-assistant destination changed.
